positions.name: PallasineChecklistScope
positions.frame: what does the Pallasine checklist cover as the onboarding process, and what did it replace?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the Pallasine checklist from the same direction: src-1 names its contents (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) and timing (first week), while src-2 locates it as a replacement for the prior wiki page. The frame asks what the checklist is and what it superseded — both members answer that question from complementary angles.
